text:
maria: Heads-up: Harbor model goes live in NA + EU tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Expected median seq len ~180, peak spikes to ~2200 at bursty moments. Ballpark peak ~6.8M tokens/sec. Need quick sanity check on GPU headroom and regional network constraints.

cheng: Do we have a routing split for launch? If we assume 70% NA / 20% EU / 10% APAC that maps to ~4.8M tps NA -> rough GPU estimate coming.

liam: Where did the tokens->GPU formula come from? Need the perf profile: seq length distribution, batch sizes, and perf per-GPU numbers.

maria: Quick profile from the perf run this morning: avg payload ~180 tokens, median batch=8 under typical traffic. Full-batch perf on A100-80G: ~110k tokens/sec/GPU. Note: lab runs are optimistic — real-world effective batching will be lower.

cheng: If we assume 50% effective batching (conservative), effective per-GPU ~55k tps. That implies NA ~87 GPUs at peak, EU ~25, APAC ~12. For a 24h sustained day at peak-window that’s ~ (87+25+12)*24 ~= 3120 GPU-hours just for peak window.

eva: Cost-wise that's an extra ~$14k-$18k/day on cloud on on-demand. Options: 1) use quantized harbor-ql (2x capacity, ~30% perf hit) in less-sensitive regions; 2) aggressive autoscale with warm pools; 3) reserve Dedicated capacity for predictable cost.

liam: APAC note: last night netops observed intermittent packet drops on the us-asia backbone in ap-southeast1 for ~30m. If packet loss persists we should avoid sending more traffic there; otherwise NA will get overflow and overload. Recommend hard caps per-region and a fallback model for overflow.

maria: Proposed operational plan:
- cap APAC to 8 GPUs at launch; enable harbor-ql fallback in APAC routing;
- pre-warm 60 GPUs in NA starting 08:00 UTC (2h before launch);
- reserve 30 GPUs in EU to avoid cross-region spill;
- set automatic fallback to gptx-small variant if p95 latency > 800ms for 5m.

cheng: I'll open the Dedicated reservation: request 90 GPUs in NA peak window, 30 EU, 16 APAC for the first 72h burn-in. Also creating a cost alert: notify if daily spend forecast > $120k.

deploy-bot: Canary started in us-west2 (10% traffic). Observability: p95 latency +12ms, tokens/sec stable at ~450k across canary pool.

eva: Question: can we reduce tail cost by throttling streaming tokens or limiting max tokens per request? Might be useful while we ramp.

liam: Oncall action items: I'll add an automated reroute script to divert 20% traffic to EU if NA p95 > 800ms for 5m. Also adding a short incident runbook section 'harbor token surge' with steps to scale down or switch to quantized variant. Snippet for routing policy: 

```
match: request.region == "apac" and backbone.loss > 0.5%
action: route_to: fallback_pool_apac (harbor-ql)
else if region == "na" and p95_ms > 800
action: route_to: eu_pool (up to 30%)
```

maria: Thanks — solid. I'll post a condensed runbook in #incidents and run the pre-warm then. @cheng please confirm reservation once finance signs off :thumbsup:

cheng: Reservation submitted to finance, pending approval (ETA ~30m). Will update thread.

deploy-bot: Finance approval received for provisional Dedicated commit (72h trial). Reservation ticket #FIN-8421.

maria: Great. After reservation confirmed, let's keep APAC cap in place and monitor netops ticket. I'll coordinate with SRE for the first 3 hours post-launch.

liam: I'll monitor p95 and token/sec dashboards, and prepare an emergency rollback to gptx-small if cost or latency degrades.

maria: Closing loop — will post hourly updates during launch and call out any reroutes. Appreciate the quick turn. :rocket:
